body: SCOUT EXACT-SHA HOLD on fec38fb. The three requested surface changes are present, but the zero-support outcome does not survive the actual public inference path. Runnable exact-candidate probe (fresh ordinary clone at fec38fb): lawful only-Sensory CostWeights + AnnaFixture -> GraphHsmm.infer returns Left(MalformedRecord("CostBreakdown", "unit u1, state seg:root: an admitted state record cannot be excluded")); 0/1, exit 1. Cause is mechanical: run builds Exclusion.Unassessable and removes it from states via !b.excluded, but returns the unfiltered breakdowns as HsmmResult.costs; HsmmResult.validated costV then rejects every cost record with exclusion.nonEmpty. So the cell is dropped from posterior state space but the proved result itself is refused, rather than routing the unit honestly to External. Required court is vertical: GraphHsmm.infer with the lawful zero-support weights is Right, source cells receive no posterior/path mass, and the exclusion record cannot be admitted as a state. Whether excluded audit costs remain serialized or are filtered is a model decision; if retained, validation must distinguish an excluded cost record from an admitted posterior/flow/path state. Also CostSuite.scala still imports unused RecallUnit; exact compile emitted the warning. No other finding yet; hsmm/v2, required AlignWire support, and resource rename are present.
